title: Linear Regression Quiz
description: Test your understanding of linear regression concepts

questions.question: What is the primary goal of linear regression?
options: To model the linear relationship between features and a continuous target
To cluster similar data points together
To reduce the dimensionality of data
questions.explanation: Linear regression models the relationship between independent variables (features) and a dependent variable (target) by fitting a linear equation to the observed data. It's used for predicting continuous values, not classification or clustering.
